tool.name: AddH3IndexField
tool.summary: Add an H3 hexagonal spatial index field to features based on their geometry centroid. The H3 index enables efficient spatial grouping and aggregation at a configurable resolution (0 = coarsest, 15 = finest). Requires the h3 Python package.

usage.bullet_item: This tool is only available when the h3 package is installed in the active Python environment.
The H3 resolution controls hexagon size: resolution 9 gives roughly 100 m edge length; lower values give larger hexagons.
Point features use their coordinates directly; polygon and polyline features use the centroid.

param.name: input_features
param.dialogReference: The feature layer or feature class to which the H3 index field will be added.

param.name: h3_resolution
param.dialogReference: The H3 resolution level (0 through 15). Higher values produce smaller hexagons. Default is 9.
